required_conditions: all geometry participating in the reduction is covered by the proved transformation
material assignments are invariant under quarter-turn_z
source terms are invariant under quarter-turn_z
boundary conditions are invariant under quarter-turn_z
requested observables are invariant or transformed consistently
absolute orientation metadata is irrelevant to the requested result
symbolic labels/glyph identity-position bindings are absent or themselves invariant
known_breakers: symbol identity tied to absolute angular position

benchmark_evidence.notes: Avrea benchmark on 250000 deterministic points, 5 repeats. Median naive 0.43998219 s; reduced 0.094110653 s. Evidence ceiling is exact geometry kernel, not full CACE solver.
